name: Ketonemia State Standard
purpose: Organize blood ketone signal language into a governed reference model. KSS does not invent medical thresholds; it organizes cited guidance and preserves the clinical boundary.
threshold_rule: KSS must never publish internally invented clinical cutoffs. When numeric ranges are used, they must cite an external source, identify population or context, state measurement type, avoid universal claims, and distinguish educational framing from medical advice.
